name: a3
title: A3 improvement review
for_each: select id,code from projects order by code

sections.title: Countermeasures
sections.sql: select title,owner,due_on,status,evidence from actions where project_id=$1 order by due_on

sections.title: Phase review evidence
sections.sql: select phase,revision,actor,evidence,created_at from phase_reviews where project_id=$1 order by created_at

sections.title: Follow-up checks
sections.sql: select title,owner,due_on,last_result,finding from v_controls where project_id=$1

sections.title: Notes
sections.sql: select actor,note,created_at from activity where project_id=$1 and action='note' order by sequence

name: benefit-register
title: Benefit evidence register
for_each: select id,code from projects order by code

sections.title: Benefits awaiting or holding review
sections.note: Hard and soft values are separate; no conversion or annualisation. This document does not certify savings.
sections.sql: select title,kind,currency,period_on,amount_cents,evidence,recorded_by,verified_by,verification_evidence,review from v_benefits where project_id=$1 order by currency,kind,period_on

sections.title: Voided entries retained for review
sections.sql: select title,kind,currency,period_on,amount_cents,void_reason,voided_by from benefits where project_id=$1 and void_reason is not null
